query: Feasibility of a Chrome browser extension that sends a YouTube or SoundCloud channel directly to DJ-CrateBuilder; present several integration approaches in a PDF
assumptions: Personal-use tool: unpacked/dev-mode extension install is acceptable; Chrome Web Store publication is a risk assessment, not a requirement
Windows is the primary target; Linux .deb channel considered secondarily
known_gaps: Chrome Local Network Access behavior for extension-originated loopback fetches is undocumented; flagged in report, not resolved
No prototypes built; effort estimates from code reading
